name: Lukka
description: Lukka is a red-aligned human bonder and planeswalker from Ikoria, a former Coppercoat of Drannith who was compleated on New Phyrexia and later killed.

description_citations.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths: card flavor text
description_citations.text: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths: card flavor text (Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Lukka is a red-aligned human bonder and planeswalker from Ikoria, a former Coppercoat of Drannith who was compleated on New Phyrexia and later killed.

citations.text: "Lukka". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.text: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths: card flavor text (Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: On Ikoria he bonded with the monster Leori, was dishonorably discharged from the Specials and banned from Drannith, and became an outcast.

citations.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After General Kudro executed Leori, Lukka touched the Ozolith, gained control of monsters, killed Kudro and besieged Drannith until the Ozolith exploded, igniting his spark and sending him to another plane.

citations.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Arcavios he bonded with a fox-like creature he named Mila, was captured by the Oriq, and helped them attack Strixhaven before fleeing with Mila when the dragons burned the mage hunters.

citations.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.
"Lukka", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

bio.text: Jace and Vivien persuaded him to join the strike on New Phyrexia, where he was separated from the team in the Hunter Maze.

citations.text: "Lukka", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citations.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

bio.text: He dominated a Phyrexian centaur hulk to guide him and Nissa, but the bond poisoned him, and he fused with it and was compleated.

citations.text: "Lukka", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy
citations.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Hard as Anger, Bright as Joy" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

bio.text: Glissa ordered him to capture Nissa alive, and Elesh Norn later sent him to Ikoria to bring its monsters into the Phyrexian ranks.

citations.text: "Lukka", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

bio.text: Returning compleated, he sacked Drannith, and Vadrok ripped him from his flesh-titan before Vivien finished him with spectral arrows.

citations.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Vivien Reid", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Lukka is dead, killed on Ikoria during the Phyrexian invasion, and a later story has Ajani saying he is dead.

citations.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citations.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: In 4561 AR a nightmare and then Leori attack Drannith; Leori kills Coppercoats but a bond rises between her and Lukka.
timeline.quote: a sudden bond rising between them stopped them both in their tracks

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kudro orders Lukka confined, but Jirina helps him escape Drannith into Savai.
timeline.quote: Jirina Kudro helped him escape Drannith and flee into Savai

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: General Kudro executes Leori himself, and Lukka feels the bond sever.
timeline.quote: felt the bond being severed as Leori died

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka gathers monsters with the Ozolith, kills Kudro with a trap, and besieges Drannith.
timeline.quote: personally killed Kudro by stabbing him in the heart

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Ozolith shatters, igniting Lukka's spark and sending him away, so the monsters wander off.
timeline.quote: causing his planeswalker spark to ignite, sending him away from Ikoria

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka looks from the parapet and sees beauty in a monster rather than a threat.
timeline.quote: Lukka looked out from the parapet and saw not a monster to be put down, but a fierce kind of beauty.

citation.text: Patagia Tiger (Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: General Kudro enacts security measures across Drannith after Lukka's betrayal.
timeline.quote: After what he viewed as Lukka's shocking betrayal, General Kudro enacted stringent security measures at every entry point into Drannith.

citation.text: Checkpoint Officer (Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lukka is ordered to kill a threat but chooses to befriend it.
timeline.quote: Lukka was ordered to kill a threat. He chose to make a friend.

citation.text: Tentative Connection (Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lukka's bond gives him his most powerful weapon.
timeline.quote: Lukka's bond provided not only friendship, but also the most powerful weapon in his arsenal.

citation.text: Go for Blood (Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Abda and Rigi meet Brin, Lukka and Vivien Reid north of Drannith; Abda greets Lukka with hostility.
timeline.quote: greeted him with hostility and warned of the dangers posed by urban factions

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph arrive; Vivien says another planeswalker disturbed the Ozolith; Abda agrees to join out of loyalty to Brin.
timeline.quote: because of her loyalty to Brin and concern for the balance of the wilds

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph join a gathering of bonders and allies in the wilds, greeted by Abda, Vivien Reid and Lukka.
timeline.quote: Zeph was immediately recognized as a formidable monster, and his presence drew attention for both his size and power.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After hearing Lukka and Vivien, Barrow becomes convinced action is needed about the Ozolith, and the pair agree to help reach it.
timeline.quote: Barrow and Zeph agreed to assist in the effort to reach the Ozolith and determine the source of its corruption.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka returns transformed and announces he controls the monsters; Barrow opposes him, saying Zeph is his partner, not a subordinate.
timeline.quote: Lukka announced that he had gained control over the monsters and intended to use this power to support Drannith.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka tries to control Zeph through the Ozolith but fails; Barrow and Zeph flee when Vivien orders the bonders to escape.
timeline.quote: Zeph remained with Barrow as they fled the scene, refusing to submit to Lukka's will

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka's army comes into view as the Siege of Drannith begins; Barrow and Zeph are held in reserve near the north gate.
timeline.quote: As the sun rose, Lukka's massive army came into view

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph lead the bonded charge through the main gate to rescue Jirina, turning the tide until Lukka is surrounded.
timeline.quote: Barrow and Zeph were the first to break through the main gate, leading the charge of bonded fighters to rescue her.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bonders and Vivien arrive at the Ozolith and plan for Lukka to reach the central crystal while the others hold off the nightmares.
timeline.quote: Vivien proposed a plan for him to reach the central crystal while the others held off the defenders

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka and his winged cat break through and Lukka touches the central Ozolith, pulled into a vision; the Vermilion arrives to retrieve him.
timeline.quote: Lukka touched the glowing crystal

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A nightmare snake brings down the Vermilion, killing Rigi, Falk and Johannes; Jirina sees Lukka in the Ozolith and Leori carries her away.
timeline.quote: while the Vermillion crashed to the ground, killing Rigi, Falk, and Johannes

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka tries to seize Zeph and Rol; Vivien hurls him away with her Arkbow and the bonders flee.
timeline.quote: attacked Lukka with her Arkbow

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka assembles an army of nightmares and sets his sights on Drannith.
timeline.quote: fully embracing his new role as their commander, and setting his sights on Drannith

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brin and Roland meet Lukka and Vivien at a crystal formation on the Egali plains and agree to help reach the Ozolith.
timeline.quote: When Vivien and Lukka proposed joining forces to reach the Ozolith, Brin agreed to help

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brin gathers bonded pairs, including Abda and Rigi and Barrow and Zeph, to coordinate a response to the disturbance in monsters.
timeline.quote: Brin's primary concern remained the safety of monsters

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka emerges altered, claiming the Ozolith has granted him control over the monsters to serve Drannith with a monstrous army.
timeline.quote: Brin listened as he explained that the Ozolith had granted him control over the monsters.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka tries to command Roland through the Ozolith; Vivien attacks him, letting Brin and the bonders flee.
timeline.quote: Vivien intervened by attacking Lukka, allowing Brin to flee.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Siege of Drannith begins at sunrise as Lukka's army appears.
timeline.quote: as the Siege of Drannith started.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien's summoned monstrosaur turns the battle and the bonders encircle Lukka, ending the assault.
timeline.quote: the bonders encircled Lukka and brought the assault to a close.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka bonds with a monster, is exiled, then besieges Drannith with monsters, killing the General, shattering the Ozolith and igniting his spark.
timeline.quote: killing the General, shattering the Ozolith, and igniting his planeswalker's spark in the process.

citation.text: "Ikoria", section "The Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka's squad faces a winged tiger that kills three of them until Lukka is bonded to it against his will.
timeline.quote: The cat kills three of his four squad members, only stopping when Lukka suddenly and unwilling bonds with the monster .

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "The bonding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kudro imprisons Lukka; Jirina helps him escape by faking her kidnapping and Vivien scares off his pursuers.
timeline.quote: Jirina helps Lukka escape by faking her kidnapping.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Outcast". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka and Vivien find the winged tiger and learn the Ozolith is forcing monsters to attack Drannith; they escape the hunters on the tiger.
timeline.quote: they escape by riding the winged tiger.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Pursuit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Ozolith Lukka connects his mind to the crystal, commands the Nightmares against the hunters and turns on Vivien and the bonders.
timeline.quote: Lukka commands all the Nightmares to attack the hunters, which leads to the pirates fleeing.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "The battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka decides to take control of the bonders' monsters and goes mad with power as Vivien flees.
timeline.quote: Lukka decides to take control of the bonder's monsters.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "The battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka witnesses the winged tiger's execution and marches his monster army on Drannith.
timeline.quote: He then witnesses the winged tiger being executed.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Marching on Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka stabs General Kudro to death at a parley; Jirina refuses to assassinate Lukka and flees into a river.
timeline.quote: He stabs General Kudro to death himself.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "The death of Kudro". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka overloads the Ozolith, which explodes, igniting his spark and sending him to another plane.
timeline.quote: This causes his planeswalker's spark to ignite and he planeswalks away.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "The Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bullied by five older boys as a youth, Lukka later takes revenge on each of them.
timeline.quote: He later exacted revenge on each of them.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After bonding with Leori, Lukka is dishonorably discharged from the Specials, banned from Drannith and made an outcast.
timeline.quote: Lukka was dishonorably discharged from the Specials, banned from Drannith, and made an outcast.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien Reid rescues and befriends Lukka, and they theorize he can neutralize the Ozolith.
timeline.quote: She rescued Lukka from his pursuers and befriended him.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at the Ozolith Lukka touches the crystal, gains great but unbalanced power, forms an army of beasts and kills General Kudro, and Jirina attacks him and flees.
timeline.quote: As Kudro refused to listen, Lukka killed him.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka's army attacks Drannith in the Siege of Drannith but Jirina's strategy and the bonders turn the tide.
timeline.quote: Lukka and his army attacked the city, starting the Siege of Drannith

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Ozolith explodes when Lukka ignores the unknown planeswalker's warning, igniting his spark as he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Lukka refused to listen and the Ozolith exploded, causing his planeswalker's spark to ignite as he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka awakes in a swamp on another world, controls one of the beasts there and vows to return home.
timeline.quote: Lukka vowed to one day return home.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka, vengeful over Leori's death and corrupted by the Ozolith, marches a monster army on Drannith after killing General Kudro.
timeline.quote: He had earlier killed General Kudro

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka's army arrives at the northern gate at dawn and breaches the walls, forcing Jirina to deploy the bonders.
timeline.quote: At dawn, Lukka's army

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "The Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina confronts Lukka on Yidaro's shell; he refuses to stop and she leaps to safety as the Ozolith surges.
timeline.quote: Lukka refused and tried to force more power from the Ozolith.

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "The Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bonders charge through the gates, rescue Jirina and turn the tide; Vivien summons a monstrosaur to distract Lukka.
timeline.quote: rescuing Jirina and turning the tide of the battle

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "The Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Ozolith explodes, severing Lukka from his beasts and igniting his planeswalker spark; he vanishes from Ikoria.
timeline.quote: triggering his planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Ignition and Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Ikoria Vivien finds the bonded Lukka and learns the Ozolith is the source of the monster attacks.
timeline.quote: Upon further investigation, a big crystal formation called the Ozolith turned out to be the source

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka takes control of the bonders' monsters and Vivien flees with the bonders.
timeline.quote: Vivien tried to fight him but had to flee with the bonders while Lukka went mad with power.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien and the bonders join Jirina's defense of Drannith; Lukka overloads the Ozolith, igniting his spark, and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: This caused his planeswalker's spark to ignite , and he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A strike team infiltrates New Phyrexia and Vraska, Nahiri, Lukka, Jace and Nissa are compleated.
timeline.quote: Vraska , Nahiri , Lukka , Jace and Nissa are all compleated .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Masked Oriq mages ambush Lukka and Mila in a desert and take Lukka prisoner.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised his hands in surrender.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: In the cave Lukka senses shelled creatures hanging around them.
timeline.quote: Slowly, whatever it was seemed to unfold, stretching long and spindly legs into the darkness.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: A masked man greets Lukka by name and offers to teach him in exchange for favors.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Arcavios, Lukka of Ikoria.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Three weeks earlier, Lukka planeswalks to Arcavios and wanders to a small farming village (flashback).
timeline.quote: his stomach still churning from planeswalking

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Villagers accuse Lukka of being an Oriq recruiter and threaten him.
timeline.quote: Okay, Oriq, I think I've heard enough.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka punches one man, then is knocked through a window by another's firebolt.
timeline.quote: Lukka got a few steps away before the firebolt splashed against the back of his coat

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka calls village animals to attack his attackers and staggers away hungry.
timeline.quote: a dog leapt through the air, its sharp teeth flashing as they sank into his arm

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Starving Lukka nearly falls from a crumbling cliff ledge.
timeline.quote: The ledge suddenly gave way beneath him, crumbling into loose stone.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka finds an injured fox-like creature under a pile of stones.
timeline.quote: A pair of golden eyes looked back out at him.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The fox leaves berries and nuts beside the fainted Lukka.
timeline.quote: A pile of berries and nuts lay beside his leg.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka forms a bond with the fox-like creature.
timeline.quote: Lukka took a deep breath and cast out his bonder's senses.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka watches a Dragonsguard confront masked Oriq agents.
timeline.quote: he could see a woman wearing immaculate robes facing a group of masked individuals

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard reflects an Oriq curse that nearly hits Lukka and rots a tree.
timeline.quote: He ducked just in time, the spell hissing horribly as it flew overhead and hit a tree to his right.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka summons the forest beasts to the clearing.
timeline.quote: Connecting with the nearby beasts, he summoned each and every one to the clearing.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard traps Lukka waist-deep in soil, calling him an untrained Oriq hedge-mage.
timeline.quote: the root creeping around his own ankle until it yanked him into the soil down to his waist

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The fox-like creature attacks the Dragonsguard with fire and fells her.
timeline.quote: a familiar shape stood over the Dragonsguard's still body, her fiery tail twitching as she sniffed at her fallen opponent

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka renews the bond and names the creature Mila.
timeline.quote: Mila it is.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus learns of a beast-calling stranger and says to let him come.
timeline.quote: Let him come.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina's owl sees a masked Oriq agent offer Lukka a silver skull mask, which he refuses.
timeline.quote: It was a silver mask, shaped like a human skull.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina confronts Lukka at the edge of the courtyard and he refuses to be anyone's pawn.
timeline.quote: It's a shame to see a man like you fallen so far.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina and Lukka fight with wind and blade.
timeline.quote: Kasmina sent a scythe of pressurized air straight at Lukka's chest.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina warns Lukka that Extus fights only for himself.
timeline.quote: Do you think Extus is going to change all that?

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina pins Lukka with her staff and demands he yield.
timeline.quote: Before he could get up, Kasmina was there, the point of her staff held just under his chin.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: A swarm of mage hunters approaches the school, and Lukka says they are just getting started.
timeline.quote: a swarm of chitinous, chittering forms scurried between the trees
